tie_reference: TIE (2026). Chemistry for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 2. Dar es Salaam: TIE.
source_note: Verified Chemistry Form Two lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary). Term I lessons 1-13 cover atomic structure, the periodic table, chemical bonding, formula writing, and chemical reactions/equations plus acids, bases and salts; lessons 10-11 follow the mid-term assessment week. Term II lessons 14-24 cover laboratory safety and qualitative analysis, volumetric analysis and gas preparation (Hydrogen, Oxygen, Carbon dioxide), and environmental chemistry (air and water pollution). Lesson plan weeks for mid-term assessments/breaks and revision/exam weeks carry no teaching content and are intentionally omitted. Content kept verbatim from the educator-verified source for offline and AI generation grounding.
